chunks: He said: And Ahmad b. al-Hasan narrated to us by this chain from Safiyya bint Abd al-Muttalib. She said:

When al-Husayn (peace be upon him) was delivered from his mother's womb, I handed him over to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). The Prophet placed his tongue in his mouth, and al-Husayn took to sucking the tongue of the Messenger of God. I reckoned that the Messenger of God was feeding him nothing but milk or honey.

She said: Then al-Husayn (peace be upon him) passed urine, and the Prophet kissed him between his eyes. Then he handed him over to me while he was weeping and saying: May God curse the nation that will kill you, O my son! He stated this thrice.
She said: So I said: May my father and my mother be ransomed for you! Who shall kill him? He said: A remnant of the party of aggressors from the Banu Umayya — may God curse them.

key_terms.الفئة الباغية: The party of aggressors — a Quranic term referring to the transgressing group
key_terms.بني أمية: Banu Umayya — the Umayyad clan, later rulers responsible for the martyrdom at Karbala
key_terms.فداك أبي وأمي: May my father and mother be ransomed for you — an expression of extreme devotion

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Imam Husayn at his birth?
ai.summary: Safiyya bint Abd al-Muttalib, the Prophet's paternal aunt, narrates the intimate moments following the birth of Imam al-Husayn (AS). The Prophet miraculously nourished the newborn by placing his tongue in the baby's mouth, then wept while cursing those who would kill his grandson — identifying them as remnants of the Banu Umayya. This narration is significant in Shia tradition as a prophetic foreknowledge of the tragedy of Karbala.

en.bilal-muhammad: He said: And Ahmad b. al-Hasan narrated to us by this chain from Safiyya b. `Abd al-Muttalib. She said:

When Husayn (as) was delivered from his mother’s womb and I handed him over to the Prophet (saww), the Prophet placed his tongue in his mouth and al-Husayn took to the tongue of the Messenger of Allah, sucking on it. I reckoned that the Messenger of Allah was feeding him either milk or honey.

She said: Then, al-Husayn (a.s.) passed urine and the Prophet kissed him between his eyes. Then he handed him over to me while he was weeping and saying: Curse of Allah be on the nation that will kill you, O my son! He stated this thrice.
She said: So, I said: May my father and my mother be ransomed for you! Who shall kill him? He said: A remnant of the party of aggressors from the Bani Umayyah (curse of Allah be on them).
